notes: Hex strings are uppercase, no separators, wire order. 'source' = 'legacy-test' (ported verbatim from the existing automated tests), 'derived' (computed by the specified algorithm; not in the legacy tests), or 'synthetic' (constructed for coverage; not a device capture).
The Android app MUST NOT write to 0xFFF3 or any vendor characteristic. These vectors document the legacy encoder so its CRC placement is understood; they are never used to build a command path.
Frame: 55 AA 00 00 03 <cmd> <lenLo> <lenHi> <crcLo> <crcHi> <payload> 0D 0A, CRC-CCITT(0xFFFF) over the payload only.
Speed cmd 05 payload = uint16 LE round(kph*10), then 01. Incline cmd 06 payload = round(percent*10) (one byte), then 00. No Start/Resume encoder exists (deliberately).
